examples.title: Basic
examples.description: A button with a text label. It is the primary variant by default.

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: The same eight variants as the preview: Primary, Secondary, Outline, Ghost, Destructive, Success, Dashed and Link. Secondary has a neutral fill, Outline a white bordered surface, Ghost stays transparent, and Success uses a filled green surface.

examples.title: With icons
examples.description: `leftIcon` and `rightIcon` place an icon beside the label. Icons are sized for you.

examples.title: Icon only
examples.description: The `icon` sizes make a square button. Give it an `aria-label`, since there is no text.

examples.title: Loading
examples.description: `loading` shows a spinner and natively disables the button, matching v1. `loadingText` replaces the label meanwhile.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: A disabled button cannot be focused or pressed.

examples.title: As a link
examples.description: `asChild` renders your own element, such as an anchor or a router link, with the button's styling.

examples.title: Full width
examples.description: Buttons are inline by default. Add `w-full` to fill the row.
